capabilities: upload pasted media files to Cloudinary
configure cloud name, upload preset and destination folder
apply default Cloudinary transformation parameters to uploads
insert resulting Cloudinary URLs into notes
extras: Uses unsigned uploads (no API key/secret required) for security reasons. Warns that malformed transformation parameters can break image rendering and that Cloudinary plans limit monthly transformations. Author points to their imgBB Uploader plugin for more customization; detailed documentation lives on an external site.
intentEvidence: This plugin allows you to automatically upload images, video, audio and raw files pasted to Obsidian directly into your Cloudinary account
problem: Obsidian stores pasted media as local vault files, which bloats the vault and doesn't work for users who want media hosted in the cloud.

relations.evidence: As this was my first time creating an Obsidian plugin, their base really helped.

summary: Cloudinary uploader that automatically uploads pasted images, video, audio and raw files to a Cloudinary account instead of storing them locally.
